CVE-2026-53615 affects libblkid DOS partition 64-bit bounds checking in util-linux before 2.41.4. The Debian security update util-linux 2.41.5-0+deb13u1 was released specifically to address the CVE-2026-5361x family for trixie and incorporates the upstream fix from v2.41.4 (commit 05c2dbadf34cc74192287f377904afaaf4061623). This version does not contain the vulnerable code path.
Package util-linux in Debian does build with readline support but chfn and chsh are provided by src:shadow and util-linux is configured with --disable-chfn-chsh.

Perl regex trie overflow in Perl_study_chunk (GHSA-whhx-pv66-xhgq) when a pattern compiles an alternation of more than 65535 fixed-string branches; the 16-bit delta overflow silently truncates the trie match table. Fixed upstream in Perl commit 03f74bbbd3 (July 2026), not yet in a Debian point release for trixie or bookworm. Perl is present only in the DHI dev variants via .apt.debian-13.inc.yaml; runtime images ship without perl. Statement will be revisited when the Debian perl package incorporates the fix.

Integer underflow and heap out-of-bounds read in berval2tl_data() in the LDAP KDB backend plugin (plugins/kdb/ldap/libkdb_ldap/ldap_principal2.c). Triggering requires a KDC or kadmind configured with an LDAP database backend whose backend returns a krbExtraData attribute with bv_len < 2; that data originates from the trusted KDB datastore, not from an external Kerberos protocol client, so it cannot be controlled by an adversary. Debian marks this unimportant (bug 1139821) with no security impact and notes it does not cross any security boundary.

False positive. CVE-2026-22184 affects the untgz utility that is part of zlib source code, but Debian zlib packages (zlib1g and zlib1g-dev) do not ship the untgz utility by default. For Debian Trixie (and other versions), zlib comes from zlib1g (binaries) and does not include the untgz binary. The vulnerability scanner incorrectly flags zlib packages as vulnerable when the untgz utility is not actually present in the installed packages.
